title: Polynomial-Time Computability of Product
statement: Encode a pair of bit strings by doubling each bit of the first string, appending the separator $01$, and then appending the second string. Decode the two components, taking a component to be empty if parsing fails, and interpret each as a binary numeral with its first bit least significant. The function sending the encoded input to the binary expansion of the product of the decoded values is polynomial-time computable.
